notes: GeNeX baseline, extended from binary to multi-class tasks. Settings follow the GeNeX paper and its released code (GenE: rotation + sharpening augmentation, Adam, settings drawn per network, uniform crossover, mutation rate 0.05 and sigma 0.01, children fine-tuned for one epoch at 1e-5 with batch 64; ProtoNeX: five expert criteria, noise std 0.1, prototypes' heads trained one epoch at 5e-5 with weight decay 1e-4 and batch 64, SLSQP weights). N, G and the number of parent pairs set the training budget. A benchmark's entry overrides any setting: on RxRx1 generation 0 trains for 18 to 22 epochs, since three to five leave its 1,139 classes far from fitted, and two generations did better than five. Paths are relative to the repository root.
